title: Grove Christian Camp

services.name: Summer camps
services.desc: Established in 1951, we've served over 9000 people, held baptisms for 1200. Located on the Row River in Dorena, Oregon, just outside of Cottage Grove. We pride ourselves for the effort we put into summer camps for kids and adults.
